OBJECTS OF THE OFFER
The Offer comprises of a Fresh Issue of 42,67,200 Equity Shares of our company at an offer price of ₹
[●] per Equity share, aggregating up to ₹ [●] Lakhs. For details, please refer to the section entitled “The
Offer” beginning on page 76 of this Draft Red Herring Prospectus.
Fresh Issue
Our Company proposes to utilize the Net Proceeds from the Issue proceeds to meet the following objects:
1. To meet the working capital requirements
2. To Finance Establishment of
a) New plating facility at Baruipur, Kolkata West Bengal
b) Proposed New B2B showroom in Ezra Street Kolkata
c) Interior and furnishing of B2C Showroom in Rash Behari Avenue Kolkata
d) Inventory cost for the proposed new showroom and stores
3. General Corporate Purpose; and
4. To meet the Offer expenses
(Collectively, herein referred as the “Objects”)
Our Company proposes to utilize the offer proceeds from the fresh issue towards funding the following
objects and achieve the benefits of listing the equity shares on the NSE Emerge platform. We believe that
the listing of Equity shares will enhance our brand name and provide liquidity to the existing shareholders.
Listing will also provide a public market for the Equity Shares in India.
The main objects and the objects incidental and ancillary to the main objects of our Memorandum of
Association enable our Company to undertake our existing business activities and to undertake the
activities for which the funds are being raised in the Fresh Offer.
